outcome: Time interval from labor induction to delivery
Time interval from induction to active phase
Vaginal delivery within 24 h of labor induction
cohort: Pregnant women with term pregnancy and unfavorable cervix
finding: Intravenous application of PGE2 is more efficacious than intracervical application for labor induction in term pregnancies with an unfavorable cervix, resulting in shorter induction-to-delivery and induction-to-active phase time intervals, and a higher prevalence of vaginal delivery within 24 h.
mod_finding: There was no significant difference in the mode of delivery between the two groups.
